items.title: Loading screen logo lacks contrast
items.what: The blue ShoeMoney 'S' logo on the loading screen has low contrast against the dark background, making it appear washed out and hard to read.
items.why: Players may not immediately recognize the brand or understand the game's identity during the first impression.
items.how: Add a subtle white or gold outline/stroke to the 'S' logo to improve visibility without breaking the warm art direction.

items.title: Fighters positioned too low in frame
items.what: In gameplay screens, the fighters occupy the lower third of the screen, leaving excessive empty tatami mat space below them.
items.why: Wastes vertical screen real estate on a portrait phone, making the action feel cramped and reducing visual impact.
items.how: Raise the camera height or adjust the dojo floor plane so fighters occupy the center 60% of the screen vertically.

items.title: Score text is hard to read mid-fight
items.what: The score numbers (e.g., '30') in the HUD use a thin, low-contrast gold font that blends into the warm background.
items.why: Players struggle to quickly check the score during fast-paced bouts, breaking immersion.
items.how: Increase the font weight of the score numbers and add a subtle dark stroke or drop shadow for contrast.

items.title: Rematch button blends into the background
items.what: The 'REMATCH' button on the results screen uses a gold-on-dark gradient that camouflages against the dojo backdrop.
items.why: Players may overlook the primary call-to-action, delaying replay and reducing engagement.
items.how: Add a high-contrast outline (e.g., white or black) to the button and increase its size by 10-15%.

items.title: Settings toggles lack visual state feedback
items.what: The toggle switches in Settings use identical off/on states with no color or icon change to indicate active/inactive.
items.why: Players cannot quickly confirm their selected options, leading to confusion or accidental changes.
items.how: Add a distinct color (e.g., warm gold for 'on') and a checkmark/icon to the active state of each toggle.
